![high](https://www.gstatic.com/codereviewagent/high-priority.svg)

Ensure that `buildInputRow` is robust against cases where `context.receipt` or `stepContext` elements are undefined/null or do not contain `item` to prevent potential `TypeError`s during dereferencing.

```javascript
function buildInputRow(context) {
  const visualRefs = context.receipt?.item ? [{
    ref_id: context.receipt.item.source_visual_receipt_id,
    artifact_path: context.paths.sourceVisualReceiptsIn,
    json_pointer: `/receipts/${context.receipt.index}`,
    review_status: context.receipt.item.review_status,
  }] : [];
  return {
    row_id: context.rowId,
    question_id: context.schedulerRow.question_row_id,
    question_part: {
      part_id: `${context.schedulerRow.question_row_id}:whole_question`,
      part_label: 'whole_question',
      part_index: 0,
    },
    source_text_refs: [{
      ref_id: refId('question_text', context.schedulerRow.question_row_id),
      artifact_path: context.paths.plainTextIn,
      json_pointer: context.plain ? `/items/${context.plain.index}` : '/items/unavailable',
      normalized_plain_text_status:
        context.schedulerRow.evidence_profile?.normalized_plain_text_status ?? null,
    }],
    method_map_refs: [{
      ref_id: refId('method_overlay', context.schedulerRow.question_row_id),
      artifact_path: context.paths.methodOverlayIn,
      json_pointer: context.overlay ? `/rows/${context.overlay.index}` : '/rows/unavailable',
      method_diagnostic_posture: context.overlay?.item?.method_diagnostic_posture ?? null,
    }],
    procedure_model_refs: [{
      ref_id: context.model?.item?.procedure_model_candidate_id ?? null,
      artifact_path: context.paths.procedureModelMapIn,
      json_pointer: context.model
        ? `/anchor_to_procedure_model_mappings/${context.model.index}`
        : '/anchor_to_procedure_model_mappings/unavailable',
      mapping_status: context.model?.item?.mapping_status ?? null,
    }],
    procedure_step_refs: context.steps.slice(0, 3)
      .filter((stepContext) => stepContext?.item)
      .map((stepContext) => ({
        ref_id: stepContext.item.procedure_step_candidate_id,
        artifact_path: context.paths.procedureStepMapIn,
        json_pointer: `/anchor_to_procedure_step_mappings/${stepContext.index}`,
        mapping_status: stepContext.item.mapping_status,
      })),
    source_visual_receipt_refs: visualRefs,
    source_visual_receipt_required:
      context.schedulerRow.evidence_profile?.requires_image_context === true,
    syllabus_alignment_refs: [],
    prior_kg_posture: {
      accepted_assertion_count:
        context.schedulerRow.current_semantic_consumption?.accepted_answer_fact_present === true ? 1 : 0,
      provisional_safe_assertion_count:
        context.schedulerRow.current_semantic_consumption?.provisional_downgraded_context_present === true ? 1 : 0,
      blocked_quarantined_assertion_count:
        context.schedulerRow.current_semantic_consumption?.raw_or_blocked_classification_status ===
          'blocked_quarantined' ? 1 : 0,
      prior_status: 'scheduled_no_prior_consumable_semantic_content',
      known_conflict_refs: [],
    },
    scheduled_selection: {
      source_scheduler_shard_id: context.schedulerRow.assigned_shard_id,
      priority_band: context.schedulerRow.priority_band,
      paper_number: context.schedulerRow.paper_number,
      paper_code: context.schedulerRow.paper_code,
      question_ref: context.schedulerRow.question_ref,
      primary_topic_path: context.schedulerRow.primary_topic_path,
      topic_component_group: context.schedulerRow.topic_component_group,
      risk_class: context.schedulerRow.risk_class,
      priority_score: context.schedulerRow.priority_score,
      selection_reason:
        'Issue #1371 bounded production selected #1370 go rows in p1_evidence_complete_text_procedure because checked-in text, ProcedureModel, and ProcedureStep evidence allow proposal-only provisional growth without flooding review queues.',
    },
  };
}
```

1. Implement defensive guards when processing data layers, rows, or file inputs to handle missing file hashes, non-array inputs, nullish entries, and validator diagnostics gracefully, preventing TypeErrors and raw file system errors.
